essentialTracks.title: No One Loves Me & Neither Do I

shortBio.en: Homme / Grohl / Jones supergroup; one-album hard-rock summit.
shortBio.zh: Homme / Grohl / Jones 超级组合；一张专辑的 hard-rock 峰会。

body.en:
Active mainly 2009–2010. Debut album stacks Homme's desert riffs, Grohl's drums (and some vocal), Jones's bass/keys—Zeppelin lineage meeting QOTSA/Foo methods.

Bridge exhibit for the chronicle: proof mid/late-career players still form short-run hard-rock units. Not a long catalog; the lineup itself is the object.
body.zh:
主要活动于 2009–2010。首专堆叠 Homme 沙漠 riff、Grohl 鼓（及部分人声）、Jones 贝斯/键盘——Zeppelin 谱系遇见 QOTSA/Foo 方法。

编年桥接展品：证明中后期职业乐手仍可组成短周期 hard-rock 单位。目录不长；阵容本身即对象。

whyMatters.en: 2009–10 hard-rock trio: Josh Homme, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones—cross-decade personnel experiment with one self-titled album.
whyMatters.zh: 2009–10 hard-rock 三人组：Josh Homme、Dave Grohl、John Paul Jones——跨年代人事实验，一张同名专辑。

note.en: Debut single—Homme riff, Grohl crash, Jones bass fill; supergroup as power trio.
note.zh: 首支单曲——Homme riff、Grohl crash、Jones 贝斯 fill；supergroup 即 power trio。

note.en: Grohl lead vocal trade-off—Foo + QOTSA + Zeppelin syntax in one track.
note.zh: Grohl 主唱交接——一曲内 Foo + QOTSA + Zeppelin 语法。

note.en: Blues-rock slow burn—Jones keys under Homme's low vocal.
note.zh: Blues-rock 慢烧——Jones 键盘垫 Homme 低人声。

body.en:
Homme, Grohl, and Jones record in Los Angeles after years of mutual guest spots. No audition—three established players, one album contract.

Homme produces; Grohl drums; Jones plays bass and adds Mellotron/keys where arrangement needs density.

Them Crooked Vultures (2009) is the only studio LP—deliberate short run.
body.zh:
Homme、Grohl、Jones 在多年互作客座后于洛杉矶录音。无 audition——三位成熟乐手，一张专辑合约。

Homme 制作；Grohl 打鼓；Jones 贝斯并在编曲需密度处加 Mellotron/键盘。

Them Crooked Vultures（2009）是唯一录音室 LP——刻意短跑。

body.en:
Mind Eraser, No Chaser splits lead vocal between Homme and Grohl—no frontman hierarchy.

No One Loves Me & Neither Do I uses Jones keyboard stabs like Zeppelin's No Quarter texture.

Mix stays dry and midrange-forward—QOTSA desert production with Zeppelin arrangement density.
body.zh:
Mind Eraser, No Chaser 在 Homme 与 Grohl 间分主唱——无 frontman 等级。

No One Loves Me & Neither Do I 用 Jones 键盘刺击如 Zeppelin No Quarter 纹理。

混音保持干、中频前置——QOTSA 沙漠制作加 Zeppelin 编曲密度。

body.en:
Band tours Europe and US in 2010—live sets extend album tracks with jam middle sections.

No second album follows; members return to Foo Fighters, QOTSA, and Jones's session work.

TCV functions as a personnel-bridge artifact: Zeppelin bass player meets Nirvana drummer meets desert-rock architect.
body.zh:
2010 年欧美巡演——现场用 jam 中段延长专辑曲。

无第二张专辑；成员回 Foo Fighters、QOTSA 与 Jones session 工作。

TCV 作人事桥接文物：Zeppelin 贝斯手遇 Nirvana 鼓手遇沙漠摇滚建筑师。
